comment: Palutena's parts shown on demand (A10, scripts/p6/look_parts.py): each a model-part variant of an existing row drawing that row's list plus cut-out cards, two-sided. Corners are in the look's rest model space (y up, she faces +z; the battle camera sees her x axis as depth, so the cards lie across y and z). The wings (forward and down smash: SetModelPartID joint 6 part 1) are the kit's wing image (godwing, its full feathered wing, the island above it cleared), one card a side sweeping up and back from her shoulder blades. The halo (up air: joint 12 part 2) is an authored gold ring above her head, tilted back.
